_comment: House style for LearnToCode lecture edits.
render.py reads this file; every key is optional and falls back to the
built-in default, so a new video can override only what it needs.
Colours are 0xRRGGBB. Geometry is in 1920x1080 pixels.

palette._row_states: upcoming 0x8a95a2 (recessive) < done 0xe8eef5 < current white+bold; a row lights up and gets a tick when it finishes -- the panel is read top-down as the lecture moves through it

_comment: Manrope (SIL Open Font License 1.1), vendored in fonts/ --
geometric grotesque, complete Cyrillic, tabular numerals.  A relative path is
resolved from the project root by render._font(), so a clone finds its own
fonts/; absolute system paths still work and a missing font stops the run with a
named key instead of failing inside the encode.  DejaVu Sans is used only for the
tick glyph (U+2713), which Manrope lacks: it comes from ttf-dejavu-core, or point
fonts.tick at any font that has U+2713.

dashboard._placement_rule: topics in one column down the right edge, not a mosaic along the bottom. Paint's canvas stops short of the screen edge, so x>=1600 below the ribbon is empty grey margin; the plate top sits at y=62, which does reach into the title-bar band -- panel_gates.py measures what the plate actually covers and the gates hide the plate wherever content is drawn there. Rows stop 16 px short of the plate's rounded bottom corner; row height grows to fill the plate when there are few topics (capped at row_h_max).

cards._recap_note: the outro card lists the topics marked recap:true in edit/topics.json -- selection is content, it lives with the topic, not here

_comment: Parameters for the size-limited copy (e-mail, Telegram).
